description.value: Boom + Batten is an elevated casual dining restaurant and café perched at Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering Pacific Northwest-inspired cuisine with inventive seasonal menus built around local and regional ingredients. The venue runs a full bar program alongside a daytime café and evening dining room, with a weather-dependent patio overlooking the harbour. It has earned awards and recognition and is a destination-worthy waterfront stop in the heart of Victoria.
